summary: Iter-21 (VozLeads widget + signup/onboarding). Backend pytest 17/17 PASS (test_vozlead_iter21.py). Covered: (1) GET/PUT /api/widget default + persistence, (2) PUT invalid color -> 422, (3) PUT with foreign-tenant agent_id -> 422, (4) GET /api/public/widget/<id> returns show:true + Access-Control-Allow-Origin:* and correct form_url=/f/<agentId>, (5) GET /api/public/widget.js is application/javascript, (6) hours_only=true + all availability days disabled -> show:false (restored after test), (7) GET /api/widget/wordpress.zip returns application/zip with 'vozleads-widget/vozleads-widget.php' containing the current widget id and VozLeads banner, (8) /api/auth/register invalid DNI '12345678A' -> 422 'El DNI no es válido (8 números y la letra)', (9) valid DNI 12345678Z and CL RUT 12.345.678-5 register successfully (200 with access_token), (10) /api/billing/checkout with signup=true returns Stripe checkout URL for new user, (11) GET /api/admin/onboarding requires admin (business JWT -> 403), (12) POST /api/admin/onboarding/<uid>/block?blocked=true on user without active line -> 400, (13) admin login + /api/public/agents/<id> regressions. Frontend (Playwright, admin logged in): /app/boton-web renders widget-agent-select, text input, color swatches (DC2626 applied, preview bg rgb(220,38,38)), position-left applied (preview button class has left-4), greeting preview bubble renders, install tabs render snippet containing <script> and data-id= in widget-code-shopify; widget-save-button persists -> reload still shows 'Llámame YA' and delay 3. widget-test.html loads shadow root #vozleads-widget with button.b 'Solicitar llamada'; clicking opens panel iframe with src /f/<agentId>?embed=1&color=%232563EB (no form submitted). /registro signup form toggles doc types ES=[DNI,NIE,Pasaporte] / CL=[RUT,Pasaporte], 4 plans, invalid DNI shows auth-error 'El DNI no es válido (8 números y la letra)'. /app/admin shows admin-onboarding-panel (0 paid customers rows, as expected). WordPress plugin flow functional end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: widget.py put_widget: ObjectId.is_valid(agent_id) + tenant_id filter is good tenant-isolation; also returns 422 for non-existent agents, which the UI maps to error toast. OK.

widget.py public_widget: Access-Control-Allow-Origin:* and no credentials/cookies on this endpoint — correct for cross-origin embed. form_url uses vapi.public_url() (APP_PUBLIC_URL) which matches REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in preview; verify in prod when a dedicated public domain is used.

widget.js: shadow DOM isolation is correct, uses document.currentScript to grab data-id, no CSS leaks. One suggestion: it unconditionally fetches /api/public/widget/<id> on every page load — safe but every page view hits the backend; the 60s Cache-Control helps for CDN but not for the first fetch. Consider a tiny client-side localStorage cache (10s) to avoid duplicate fetches on SPA navigations.

onboarding.valid_doc: NIE validation uses int("XYZ".index(n[0]).__str__() + n[1:8]) which works but is unreadable; prefer int(f"{'XYZ'.index(n[0])}{n[1:8]}"). RUT formatting ('.' thousands) is cosmetic — fine. DNI/NIE/RUT algos all correct and tested.
onboarding.assign: On Vapi failure persists {status:'error'} then raises HTTPException(400) with 'No se pudo conectar la línea: ...' — matches the admin UI toast expectation. Good.
onboarding.pending: filters paid or has tenant_numbers doc — correct. Also includes doc_type/doc_number/country/billing — enough for admin UI.

server.register: when doc_number provided, nests first_name/last_name/doc_type/billing_address INSIDE the `if body.doc_number:` block. If a client registers via the legacy /registro without a doc_number, those billing fields are silently dropped. Low risk because the UI always sends doc_number — but worth decoupling: billing_address/first_name/last_name should be saved regardless of whether doc_number is present.
SignupForm: window.location.href = r.data.checkout_url || r.data.url — defensive, good. On billing/checkout failure navigates to /app/plan with a toast — reasonable fallback.
AdminOnboarding Row.enter: redirects to /app/numero via window.location.href after impersonate — OK, forces a full reload so cookies refresh.

widget-test.html still points at admin's current widget id (hardcoded data-id). This is fine for testing but if the admin agent is deleted/deactivated the test page would stop rendering the button. Low priority.
seed_data_creation: Pytest creates 2-3 TEST_*@vozlead-test.es|cl users during signup tests and deletes them in teardown_module via direct MongoDB cleanup. No tenant_numbers docs are created (users never reach paid state). Widget settings are reset to defaults by the Playwright script after persistence check so the admin's live widget-test.html still works. Availability was toggled off then restored to original days+slot_minutes within the same test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Widget: /api/widget (GET/PUT), /api/public/widget/<id> (CORS *), /api/public/widget.js, /api/widget/wordpress.zip — all working. Public widget config includes form_url=/f/<agentId> (uses APP_PUBLIC_URL). Widget-test.html at /widget-test.html uses admin widget id — DO NOT delete admin's seeded TEST agent. Signup requires first_name/last_name/business_name/email/password + doc_type/doc_number validated by onboarding.valid_doc (ES: DNI/NIE/Pasaporte, CL: RUT/Pasaporte). Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... python -m pytest tests/test_vozlead_iter21.py -n 0.
